title: Jammed Juicy Filipino Serrano Ham Sisig
description: A Filipino dish featuring serrano ham, with a jammy and cheese-pull texture, served in a lacquerware bowl, low in sodium and energizing to eat. This sisig recipe is a twist on the traditional Filipino appetizer.
instructions: Dice the serrano ham and chicken liver into small pieces and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat and saute the diced onion until translucent.
Add the diced serrano ham and chicken liver to the pan and cook until the ham is lightly browned.
Add the calamansi juice to the pan and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked ham and liver mixture, mayonnaise, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix well until the cheese is fully incorporated and the mixture is jammy.
Add the sliced green chili, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a lacquerware bowl and serve immediately.
